snuff.label: Snuff the lantern
snuff.line: Every Dread gem you clear is fuel taken from its lantern; empty it and the Wisp goes out with it

dissolve.label: Dissolve the slip jelly
dissolve.line: Let its slime pile up on your half, Transmute the slime, and clear 9 of those gems in one turn; with nothing left to hold it together, the slip jelly falls apart

clapback.label: Clap back
clapback.line: Release your drag on its clap and clear, three turns in a row; it loses its rhythm and claps itself to pieces
